content: Cloudflare 2017 leap second post-mortem: wall clock went backwards 1s, smoothed negative RTT fed rand.Int63n -> panic -> partial DNS outage across 102 DCs; fix was clamping negative deltas. Meituan Leaf blog: 2017 leap second caused clock rollback on some production machines; startup check comparing local time to ZK-persisted last-seen time prevented duplicate IDs. bwmarrin PR #69: monotonic anchoring only helps within a process run; restart after clock rollback is undetectable without persisted state (stateless services can't detect it at all). Docker Desktop issue: VM clock freezes during host sleep.
